sn29.8:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
sn29.8:1.3: ‘‘ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā jalābujānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī’’ti?…Pe…
sn29.8:1.5: ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā jalābujānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
